claims.text: We report competitive results on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
We show competitive results on Wall Street Journal (WSJ) and 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard (F+S).
Our architecture leads to SOTA results on LibriSpeech and competitive results on other benchmarks.
